statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic contributors to these symptoms.
CPT code 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's symptoms.
Diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I49.5 support this clinical need.
The claim for CPT code 93226 has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code PR-204.
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
